subject: zEntVillain_Init
evidence: The target calls zEntInit, installs event/update/bound/move callbacks, chooses the subtype handler table, reads configuration and subtype flags, resets the entity, initializes its rotation and guard position, and chooses the Space Kook renderer for subtype 15.

subject: g_npcFuncs
evidence: The target data has 51 rows of thirteen words, indexed by subtype; its complete sequence of flags, zeros and named handler relocations agrees with the rev0 target table.

subject: fn_800A8CB8
evidence: This address-labeled reset path calls xEntReset, clears the 0x6A4-byte villain-specific tail, reinstalls callbacks and subtype handlers, reads settings, resets the entity again and calls InitDep. The rev0 label is used in source; the rev1 target labels the corresponding body 0x800A8AC0. Its original name is unknown.

subject: g_npcFuncs relocation comparison
evidence: In lane C before integration, the compiled initializer and target object each had 503 relocations within g_npcFuncs, at identical offsets and to identical named symbols; objdiff compared the data at 100%. That source object had 32 undefined handler symbols, so this does not establish complete source or executable equivalence.

subject: VILN_std_query
evidence: The target jump table dispatches the standard movement, attack and player detection queries; the implementation follows the checks of ability, allow and movement flags, navigation state, precalculated player flags and recursive handler queries. The target gives zero for unhandled questions. Conditions and source shape remain subject to instruction comparison and review.

subject: VILN_gang_stimulus
evidence: The target goal and stimulus tables dispatch gang lifecycle, conversation, movement and guard cases. During an existing conversation it stops the sound parent, updates the talk SFX, queues its sound when present, and sets the fidget timing; navigation uses the existing widget and path helpers. The address-labeled sound-stop call takes the villain address plus two as its parent ID.

subject: VILN_gang_stimulus sound-stop call
evidence: The rev1 target calls the address-labeled fn_8003CD40 with the villain address plus two as its sound-parent ID. Shared source currently refers to rev0 label fn_8003CD24; this remains unresolved for rev1 and the unit stays NonMatching.

subject: zEntVillain_Startup
evidence: The target increments the startup count, allocates and clears 0x20000 bytes on the first start, traverses the three sentinel-terminated tables, hashes animation names, invokes zVIL_setup_npcTable and hashes them again, then registers four boss projectile callback and property records. The target callback templates begin at 0x8019E5FC; their function relocations and property words determine the local records. Several callback bodies remain unsourced.

subject: zVIL_setup_npcTable
evidence: The target iterates 50 subtype entries through a switch, sets their ability, personality, physics and collision flags, masks penetration flags using movement flags, and installs standard handlers when the handler flag lacks bit 0. The personality register persists across iterations and boss cases only assign boss personality when it is zero. Case constants and fallback handlers follow the target; source form and behavior remain subject to review.

subject: fn_800D4350
evidence: The .ctors entry points to this routine; it hashes the eight KEY OFF/ON UI strings and stores the results in the same eight words updated by the UI initializer. Dynamic initialization of the file-scope identifiers accounts for this behavior.

subject: zUI_Render model vectors

subject: zUIRenderAll sorted reads
